subject: City Charter Review Committee Process
overview: The council debated establishing a charter review committee and heard a presentation from a community group regarding alternative redevelopment plans for the Malden Hospital site. Members voted to seek a legal opinion on the charter review process and addressed various traffic safety and maintenance requests.

items.title: Malden Hospital Redevelopment Proposal
items.summary: A community group presented an alternative development plan for the Malden Hospital site, emphasizing lower density and environmental preservation compared to current developer proposals. The council passed resolutions to coordinate with the City of Malden and the Traffic Commission to mitigate potential traffic impacts on Medford neighborhoods.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognitions and Condolences
items.summary: The council offered condolences to the families of firefighter Timothy Brennan and Kenneth Nesta, and congratulated the Tufts University softball team and several Medford High School athletic teams on their championships.

items.title: Establishment of City Charter Review Committee
items.summary: The council voted to request a legal opinion from the City Solicitor regarding the process for establishing a committee to review the city's 30-year-old charter. Proponents argued the review is necessary for modernization and better checks and balances, while opponents suggested such changes should remain purely citizen-driven via petition.

items.title: Taxi Operator License Petitions
items.summary: Approved taxi operator licenses for Jean Elsan Dumas and Joseph Pierre; the license for Sandro Mathieu was approved following a brief tabling to clarify business location details.

items.title: Traffic Safety and Infrastructure Requests
items.summary: Approved requests for the Traffic Commission to review crosswalks at Victory Park and Forest Street, and for the DPW to evaluate Bell Avenue for repaving.

items.title: Governor's Avenue Wall Maintenance
items.summary: Referred a request to the Department of Public Works to clean brush and overgrowth from the Governor's Avenue wall.

items.title: Update on 56 Boynton Road
items.summary: Requested an update from the City Solicitor regarding the probate court status of a condemned property on Boynton Road.

items.title: Digital Access to City Budget
items.summary: Passed a motion requesting that the city administration make the municipal budget accessible online in a searchable PDF format.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The council approved the minutes of the May 26, 2015, meeting.
